verdict.rationale: Anti-bot evasion is a fair axis for a cloud headless-browser platform, but the evidence pack never documents an undetected, stealth or fingerprint-evasion browser mode. The only related material is a marketing line saying CAPTCHAs and login prompts are 'handled'. That is challenge handling, an adjacent feature rather than a mode that avoids detection, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use an undetected browser mode to bypass sophisticated bot detection systems
